item.title: IND v NZ 2026: WATCH- “No one is thinking about Arshdeep Singh”- R Ashwin fumes on pacer’s constant snub from Indian team
item.description: R Ashwin, an Indian legend and current commentator, went on a social media tantrum after bowler Arshdeep Singh was benched in the first and second ODIs against New Zealand. Though there is speculation that Arshdeep would play the final match of the series, Ashwin believes the left-arm pacer should be an untouchable figure in the fast-bowling unit. item.title: WPL 2026: ‘Wasn't a spontaneous decision’- UPW coach Abhishek Nayar on retiring out Harleen Deol against DC
item.description: UP Warriorz head coach Abhishek Nayar explained the decision to retire out batter Harleen Deol in the previous WPL 2026 game against Delhi Capitals (DCW). Nayar revealed that Harleen was not happy about the decision and conveyed the same to him. Harleen was batting on 47 off 36 balls, and there were just three overs remaining when Nayar called her in. However, Harleen took the incident in her stride and starred with a match-winning knock in UPW’s next WPL match against the Mumbai Indians Women.

item.title: “Coach’s inputs must be there”- Manoj Tiwary says Gambhir influenced Agarkar in removing Rohit Sharma as ODI captain
item.description: Former India cricketer Manoj Tiwary believes head coach Gautam Gambhir played a hand in Rohit Sharma's dismissal as India's ODI captain, accusing him of potentially 'influencing' Ajit Agarkar to make the decision. Tiwary, whose feud with Gambhir is not new, believes the decision-makers humiliated Rohit by taking the position away from him. item.title: ICC fixes its mistake over days spent by Virat Kohli as no.1 ranked ODI batter after fans’ backlash
item.description: After receiving severe backlash from fans, the ICC had to fix a glaring error made by them while sharing a stat about the number of days Virat Kohli spent as the No. 1-ranked batter in ICC ODI rankings. For the first time in almost five years, Virat Kohli has risen to the top of the ICC ODI rankings thanks to his incredible recent form. item.title: IND v NZ 2026: Shreyas Iyer and Ravi Bishnoi added to India squad for New Zealand T20Is; Washington Sundar ruled out entirely
item.description: The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI), on January 16, 2026, named the replacement players for the injured duo of Washington Sundar and Tilak Varma for the upcoming five-match T20I series between India and New Zealand. The five-match series, which will be India’s last bilateral assignment before the T20 World Cup 2026, will begin on January 21 in Nagpur. item.title: IND v NZ 2026: “Only maintained a strike rate of 60,” Pathan blames Jadeja’s slow knock for India’s second ODI loss
item.description: New Zealand outclassed India across departments to register a series-levelling seven-wicket victory in the second ODI at Niranjan Shah Stadium, Rajkot on Wednesday (January 14). item.title: IND v NZ 2026: “He always goes for runs,” Kaif slams Indian team management for preferring Prasidh Krishna over Arshdeep Singh
item.description: The Indian team management has come under the scanner for making Arshdeep Singh warm the bench in the first two ODIs against New Zealand at home. The left-arm quick was excellent in the preceding three-ODI series against South Africa, claiming at least one wicket in each game for a total of five scalps at an average of 30.80.
